text_en: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the Israelites defeated, whose land they occupied beyond the Jordan toward the east, from the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon, with all the Arabah eastward:
text_cn: 以色列子民在约但河东岸所占领的地区，是自阿尔农谷直到赫尔孟山和东边的全阿辣巴。以下是他们所征服的地区的王子：

text_en: King Sihon of the Amorites who lived at Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, and from the middle of the valley as far as the river Jabbok, the boundary of the Ammonites, that is, half of Gilead,
text_cn: 一个是住在赫市朋的阿摩黎王息红；他管辖的地区，是从阿尔农谷旁的阿洛厄尔起，包括山谷中心，基肋阿得的一半，直到位于阿孟子民的边界雅波克河；

text_en: and the Arabah to the Sea of Chinneroth eastward, and in the direction of Beth-jeshimoth, to the sea of the Arabah, the Dead Sea, southward to the foot of the slopes of Pisgah;
text_cn: 东边有阿辣巴，上至基乃勒特海，下至阿辣巴海，即盐海；东到贝特耶史摩特，南到丕斯加山麓。

text_en: and King Og of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei
text_cn: 另一个是巴商王敖格，他原是勒法因的遗民，住在阿市塔洛特和厄德勒。

text_en: and ruled over Mount Hermon and Salecah and all Bashan to the boundary of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and over half of Gilead to the boundary of King Sihon of Heshbon.
text_cn: 他统治赫尔孟山区，撒耳加和巴商全境，直到革叔尔人和玛阿加人的边界，以及另一半基肋阿得直到赫市朋王息红的边界。

text_en: Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the Israelites defeated them; and Moses the servant of the Lord gave their land for a possession to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
text_cn: 上主的仆人梅瑟和以色列子民征服了他们，上主的仆人梅瑟遂将地分给了勒乌本人、加得人和默纳协半支派，作为产业。

text_en: The following are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the Israelites defeated on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, that rises toward Seir (and Joshua gave their land to the tribes of Israel as a possession according to their allotments,
text_cn: 以下是若苏厄和以色列子民，在约但河西岸，从黎巴嫩山谷的巴耳加得起，直到上色依尔去的哈拉克山，所征服的地区的王子：──若苏厄将这地，照以色列各支派分给了他们作产业：

text_en: in the hill country, in the lowland, in the Arabah, in the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the Negeb, the land of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites):
text_cn: 即赫特人、阿摩黎人、客纳罕人、培黎齐人、希威人和耶步斯人所住的山区、平原、阿辣巴、山坡、旷野和乃革布──
